about.title: A Passion for the Perfect Steak
about.description: At Western Road Steak & Grill, we believe an extraordinary steak begins with extraordinary ingredients. We source our beef from the world's finest farms, age it with meticulous care, and entrust it to our expert grill masters who cook each cut to its ideal temperature. Every plate that reaches your table is the culmination of years of expertise and an unwavering passion for the craft of grilling.

testimonials.title: What Our Guests Say
testimonials.subtitle: Real reviews from our valued guests

items.name: Abdullah Al-Mutairi
items.text: The best steak I have ever had in Tabuk, hands down. The quality of the meat, the grilling, and the presentation are all world-class. Worth every riyal.

items.name: Fahad Al-Anazi
items.text: Visited with my family and it was a wonderful experience in every way. The ambiance is upscale, the service excellent, and the food is beyond description. We will definitely return.

items.name: Sultan Al-Rashidi
items.text: The Tomahawk steak here is out of this world. Incredibly tender with a distinctive smoky flavor. I recommend it to everyone. One of Tabuk's finest restaurants.

items.name: Mohammed Al-Shammari
items.text: A place that combines luxury with great taste. The ribeye steak is outstanding and the service is fast and professional. A perfect 10 out of 10 from me.
